summary: The narrator and his friends Darryl, Van and Jolu are searching for a signal with their wifinders when they are confronted by a pink-haired girl in costume-like clothing who threatens to report them to truant watch with a candid photo unless they leave the clue to her team. Before the standoff resolves, an earthquake strikes, a deafening roar follows, and a huge black cloud rises from the northeast. The excerpt is from the first part of a fiction novel titled Book 1.
one_line: Teen wifinder hunters in California face a pink-haired rival team's photo threat just as an earthquake and a black cloud erupt.
key_facts: Darryl and Van carry phones with built-in wifinders, while Jolu uses a separate small directional fob.
Jolu is too cool to carry a phone bigger than his pinky finger, according to the narrator.
The narrator tells the group to look for a sharp drop off in the signal that gets worse the more they move along it.
The pink-haired girl has a shock of bright pink hair, a sharp rodent-like face and big sunglasses that are practically air-force goggles.
The girl wears striped tights beneath a black granny dress with Japanese decorer toys safety pinned to it.
The girl photographs the narrator and his crew and calls it candid snitch-cam.
She threatens to send the photo to truant watch in thirty seconds unless the four back off from the clue.
She offers to let the narrator's group return in one hour to take the clue, saying it is more than fair.
Three other girls in similar garb have blue, green and purple hair.
The girl says her team is going to kick the narrator's team's ass at Harajuku Fun Madness.
Van's all-girls school is notorious for its brawls, and Van appears ready to fight the girl.
The narrator says that when Californians feel the cement lurch beneath their feet, they know it instinctively as an earthquake.
The earthquake is accompanied by an incredible roaring sound, louder than anything the narrator has heard before.
The roar drives the narrator to his knees, and Darryl points out a huge black cloud rising from the northeast.
